_comment: The four onboarding scenarios from IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 11.
These are FIXTURES, NOT WORKFLOWS (section 1.4). A case number may appear
only in demo routing, fixture loading and test names. application_service,
the comparison engine, authority_builder and authority_engine never receive
or inspect one. `expected_verdict` is a test and demo-card assertion; no
business code may read it, and no engine may branch on any value in here.
Adding a fifth scenario must require only another entry in this file.
